points.why: Says the label is a verdict that makes people argue with it rather than the substance, and that the framing blames the room.
Opens with an undisputed event and adds one link at a time on a whiteboard, checking each against their experience.
Waits for the room to state the pattern before naming it, and treats each objection as a link or boundary to fix or defend.
Keeps blame out of nodes and links, and distinguishes the team being informed afterward from being consulted.
